rationale: CRISPRi lncRNA screen (CRiNCL U87 sublibrary, 10 guides per lncRNA, 450 non-targeting guides) in U87 dCas9-KRAB cells seeded in Matrigel Boyden chambers for 24 h (Tsung et al. 2024). The cells that stayed in the top chamber (non-invading, 'After') are compared with the cells before seeding ('Before'); knockdowns that reduce invasion are enriched in the top chamber, which is how the paper defines hits (LINC03045 = LH02236, ZNF215-AS1 = LH02727). Gene labels come from the CRiNCL library table (prepare.R). Two screen replicates per arm; the replicate numbers match across arms but the correlations show no pairing (After_Rep_5 correlates more with Before_Rep_6 than with Before_Rep_5), so no replicate term is used, leaving 2 residual degrees of freedom.
